answer_1.quote: we propose two tasks, explanation generation for pun classification and keyword-conditioned pun generation, to advance research on humor understanding and generation.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we calculate word incorporation rate for both pun words and keywords. Additionally, we run human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk...

answer_4.quote: we run human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk, in which we asked Turkers to label whether or not a given generated pun was successful.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers were asked to label whether the generated pun was successful (defined as whether the text supports both senses of the pun word).
